people.imagined: Cold ravine dawn. He sits upright on a flat rock with his hands in his lap, listening, and one long forefinger lifts and taps the rhythm of whatever he hears: pine wind, a distant footstep, the breath of the person looking at him.
people.subject: The moment: at cold ravine dawn he sits upright on a flat rock among drifting mist, head slightly turned as if to hear, one long forefinger lifted and tapping the rhythm of the air. Face: a long, narrow, ascetic old face, deeply lined; skin pale and papery over high cheekbones; eyes half-closed, pale grey-brown, turned inward on a sound; thin white brows long and straight; a long thin nose; a thin mouth in a very faint smile; a fine wispy white beard hanging to the chest. Hair: long white hair in a high topknot, held by a jade zither pin carved with seven strings. Body: tall, thin and very upright, the hands long and fine. Clothing: the head's richest dress: layered robes of soft grey silk with three crossed collars embroidered in silver thread with zither strings and ravine pines, wide sleeves falling in long folds, a silk cord sash hung with a jade pendant; over it a pale ravine-blue gauze over-robe so fine that the wind lifts one edge. Hands and objects: both hands rest on his knees; every fingernail of the right hand is grown long, hard, pale and curved like a row of plectra, drawn large in the lower centre, while the left nails are square-cut. Background: dark pines dissolving in blue-grey mist, a hint of ravine wall. Power: faint green-brown threads of wood qi drift upward from the strings of his sleeve, with a few silver motes of wind turning slowly about him. Light: cold silver dawn from the upper left, a bright rim along the nails and the gauze. Expression: remote, serene, listening.

people.imagined: Night in the instrument rooms. He is bent under a single lamp over a half-carved board of storm-pine, shavings in his eyebrows, the crushed fingers of his left hand holding the wood steady while he looks round at the door.
people.subject: The moment: at night, under one lamp, he is bent over a half-carved soundboard and has glanced up toward a door left ajar. Face: a broad, heavy, bearded face; skin ruddy and rough; thick bushy eyebrows full of pale sawdust, the first thing seen; small suspicious dark eyes; a big nose; a wide mouth drawn tight; a short thick black-grey beard. Hair: black-grey, cropped short and tied under a jade-grey headcloth, shavings caught in it. Body: heavy, thick-armed, wide-shouldered, hunched over the bench. Clothing: an elder's grey silk robe with two crossed collars, the borders embroidered with zither strings and pine sprigs in silver thread, the wide sleeves tied back with silk cords; a silk cord sash hung with a small jade mallet and a jade pendant; fine pale dust lies on the shoulders and in the folds, a halo of it around his head. Hands and objects: his left hand, laid flat on the pine board, has the last two fingers crushed flat and fused, bright in the lamplight; the right holds a small curved chisel; the board has a rough zither shape, pale and fresh. Background: a dark warm workshop, zither bodies in rows on racks, chisels hung in order of size, curls of pale pine shaving across the floor. Power: a thin gold-pale shimmer of metal qi runs along the chisel edge, with a few green motes of wood qi drifting in the lamp beam. Light: a warm single lamp from the lower left, with a faint spirit-glow in the shavings. Expression: a wary, stubborn, absorbed frown, a man who does not want to be disturbed.

people.imagined: A midwinter pre-dawn. She has stopped at a rest in the canon and the room has stopped breathing. Her hands hover above the strings. She is thinking of the twelfth movement and does not let it show.
people.subject: The moment: she sits at a dark old zither with both hands hovering motionless above the strings in the middle of a rest, her face utterly still. Face: a small, fine, pale oval face; skin cool and smooth; very still dark eyes looking down under lowered lashes; thin even brows; a small straight nose; a small closed mouth with no expression at all, a faint tension at one corner of the lips. Hair: black and perfectly smooth, parted in the middle, gathered in a long low knot at the nape with a slender jade pin shaped like a pine needle. Body: small, slight, composed, perfectly balanced. Clothing: the heir's dress: soft grey silk with a high crossed inner collar and two outer collars, bordered with silver zither strings and pines, wide sleeves falling in layered folds over the table, a silk cord sash with a small jade pendant, and over her shoulders a pale ravine-blue gauze scarf. Hands and objects: both hands are held two inches above the silk strings; the nails of the right hand are long, pale and hard like plectra, the left square-cut; the strings are drawn finely and lit. Background: a hall of pale wood and paper screens, thin pine shadows moving on the paper, the dark mist beyond. Power: pale-gold motes of metal qi gather and hang motionless above the strings, held like her breath. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left, a cool rim along her cheek, a silver gleam on the strings. Expression: absolute stillness, a held breath.

people.imagined: A banquet. He has a cup in one hand, the other raised for emphasis, telling the envoy story for the hundredth time, certain the room is with him, his scarlet sash bright as a wound.
people.subject: The moment: at a banquet he raises one hand in a grand gesture, a wine cup in the other, telling a story with a handsome self-satisfied smile. Face: a handsome, long, well-formed face of an ageing beauty; smooth tanned skin with a few fine lines; perfectly arched dark brows; large bright dark eyes shining with self-regard; a straight nose; a full mouth in a practised, charming smile; a neat short beard shaped to a point. Hair: black with silver at the temples, glossy, in a tall neat topknot with a jade zither pin. Body: tall, upright and elegant, the shoulders thrown back, a man who knows where the light falls. Clothing: an elder's fine grey silk robe with three crossed collars embroidered with zither strings and pines in silver, wide sleeves falling in long folds, and round the waist a broad, bright scarlet silk sash with long tassels, the brightest object in the picture, hung with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted in a grand gesture, the long nails polished; the left holds a small porcelain wine cup, a drop of wine at its rim. Background: a lantern-lit hall, blurred guests leaning in with their cups, a screen painted with pines, a servant bending with a flask. Power: soft green wood qi curls like vine tendrils from his raised sleeve, and a few warm orange sparks of fire qi glitter near the cup. Light: golden lantern light from the upper left with a soft glow on the silk, flushing his cheeks. Expression: a bright, practised, self-satisfied smile, an old tale told once too often.

people.imagined: In the string room, counting silk threads under her breath, humming a half-tone flat, twisting a new string between ivory-coloured fingers, a coil of thin green wire on her wrist.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a work bench, she twists a silk string between her fingers and hums slightly flat, her eyes on the thread. Face: a plain, narrow, patient face; skin tanned; dark eyes lowered to the work, narrowed; straight brows; a small nose; a mouth shaped round a hum; a faint furrow between the brows. Hair: black with a grey streak, gathered up under a pale grey silk wrap pinned with a small jade comb. Body: small, thin, bent over the work. Clothing: a tidy robe of soft grey silk with two crossed collars embroidered with zither strings in silver thread, wide sleeves tied back neatly with silk cords, a cord sash; on her left wrist a loose coil of very thin green malachite wire, and on a loop at her belt tiny bronze scissors. Hands and objects: the fingertips of both hands are the colour of old ivory, stained pale by silk dust, large in the foreground; she twists three silk threads into a fine cord; spools of thread hang on a rack. Background: a workroom of racks of coloured silk skeins, a window of pine branches, a small teapot on a stove with a thin plume of steam. Power: a faint pale-gold shimmer of metal qi runs along the taut thread and the wire. Light: soft moonlit window light from the upper left, the pale silk glowing from below on her face. Expression: an absorbed, counting look, the lips moving through the beats, humming a shade flat.

people.imagined: The ravine road with the patrol. He plays a marching phrase on a zither slung at the hip, striding, the green soldier's cord pulled out of his sleeve for the captain and then thrust back when he sees an old man in the distance.
people.subject: The moment: marching along a ravine road at blue dawn, he glances over his shoulder and shoves a green plaited cord up into his sleeve. Face: a strong, handsome, hard face; brown skin; thick straight brows; keen narrow eyes with a sideways look; a straight nose; a firm mouth in a half-smirk; a clean-shaven chin. Hair: black, in a high tight topknot bound with a plain black silk cord and a slim silver pin. Body: broad-shouldered, athletic, a soldier's stride. Clothing: an inner disciple's soft grey silk robe cut a little shorter for the road, two crossed collars embroidered with zither strings in silver, the wide sleeves bound at the wrist with silk cuffs, a silk cord sash with a jade pendant; a short zither on a padded strap across his back. Hands and objects: the right hand stuffs a plaited green cord into the left sleeve, its end still showing; the left fist is closed on the strap. Background: a pine ravine road with mist rising from the depths, blurred soldiers in a loose column marching behind under an unmarked green banner, and far off the grey shape of an old man half hidden by a trunk. Power: a few pale green motes of wood qi cling to the strings of the zither and trail behind him. Light: cool silver morning light from the upper left with a bright rim along the shoulder. Expression: a brisk, defiant, slightly furtive look over the shoulder, daring anyone to ask about the cord.

people.imagined: On the terrace at midday, nodding off against a pine with his zither half in his lap, a red pillow-crease down his cheek, one eye barely open, with an empty pine-nut bucket at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: slumped against a pine trunk at midday, eyes half open, a deep red crease across his cheek. Face: a round, soft, drowsy face; heavy-lidded eyes barely open; a red crease from a pillow prominent across the left cheek, drawn large; soft round brows; a snub nose; a loose half-smile; flushed skin. Hair: tousled brown hair sticking up on one side, a pine needle in it, a plain wooden pin about to fall out. Body: soft, round-shouldered, sprawled, one leg stretched. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple, clean but rumpled, the collar crooked so both crossed collars show unevenly, with a faint silver pine border; wide sleeves in loose folds, a silk cord sash trailing on the ground, one shoe off and lying a few steps away. Hands and objects: both hands rest on a small zither in his lap; at his feet an empty wooden bucket; a pine needle is caught in his collar and a thread of drool glints at the lip. Background: a sunlit pine terrace in drifting mist, a line of other students in grey working in a blur at the next level down, a squirrel watching from a branch, a pale gold haze rising from the ravine. Light: soft golden spirit-light from the upper left through the branches, a gentle rim on his cheek. Expression: blissful, unbothered drowsiness, the mouth soft, the gaze drifting somewhere past the viewer as if he has only just remembered where he is.

people.imagined: In a practice hall, she flips a coin behind her back to decide, a new coloured thread knotted into her hair today, while a patient young man waits with a tuned zither.
people.subject: The moment: flipping a coin over her shoulder without looking, a quick sly smile on her face. Face: a sharp, lively, narrow face; bright, quick dark eyes; arched brows; a pointed chin; a small mischievous mouth; high cheekbones. Hair: black, in a long braid with a bright orange thread knotted at the front and several other bright threads of different colours tied along its length, each distinct as the braid swings, and a tiny silver pin at the crown. Body: slim, quick and upright, her weight on the right hip and the left arm swung back, an energetic posture. Clothing: graceful grey silk of an inner disciple, two crossed collars edged in silver zither-string embroidery, wide sleeves pushed up to the elbow and caught with silk ties, a silk cord sash with a small bamboo plectrum case on a jade toggle. Hands and objects: the right hand behind her back flicks a small copper coin in a high arc; the left holds a zither plectrum. Background: a bare, clean practice hall of polished boards and pale paper screens, a low zither on a table, a window glowing with soft morning mist, and blurred in the corner a patient young man in grey holding a tuned zither on his knees and watching the ceiling. Power: a few pale gold motes of metal qi sparkle in the air around the spinning coin. Light: bright silvery side light from the upper left. Expression: a playful, sly, arbitrary smile, the small mouth tucked up at one corner and the quick dark eyes sparkling, a girl who tosses the coin before she decides.

people.imagined: He is just sitting down at a long table and has knocked on its edge, head tilted, to hear it ring, a quiet pleased look on his face.
people.subject: The moment: knocking a knuckle on a table edge with his head tilted, listening for the ring. Face: a plain, earnest, mild face; brown skin with grey stone-dust in the creases; large ears; eyes half-closed in listening; mild brows lifted; a wide nose; a gentle mouth with a faint smile. Hair: brown, short and bristling, grey with stone dust, a plain wooden pin in a tiny knot. Body: stocky, small and broad, with miner's shoulders hunched in toward the table, the head cocked, the big ears standing out. Clothing: the plain graceful grey silk of an outer disciple, clean but a size too large, two crossed collars with a thin silver pine border, the wide sleeves folded back twice, a silk cord sash; grey stone dust lies in the folds around the knuckles. Hands and objects: the right knuckles tap a smooth wood table edge; the left hand holds a small tuning bell, still and open. Background: a long meal hall of dark wooden tables and benches, bowls of millet and pine nuts, a few students blurred eating in silence, shafts of pale misty window light across the floor, a small bronze bell on a post. Power: a faint pale-gold ripple of metal qi spreads from the knuckle like a ring on water. Light: soft silvery light from the upper left, a faint rim on the big ears. Expression: a mild, humble, satisfied smile, the eyes half closed and the whole face given over to the ring of the wood.

people.imagined: On the rim above the ravine, she grins at a pilgrim with a stack of copied pages in her arms and a bamboo flute through her sash, the missing front tooth in the middle of a confident smile.
people.subject: The moment: grinning wide at a pilgrim, a stack of loose pages held against her chest, a bamboo flute through her sash. Face: a wide, cheeky, freckled face; bright black eyes; strong straight brows; a snub nose; a broad grin with a clear gap where a front tooth is missing, big and plain. Hair: short, rough black hair tied up with a green bamboo thread and a small jade bead. Body: small, wiry and bold, leaning toward the pilgrim with her chin up and shoulders squared. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful grey silk, two neatly crossed collars with silver zither-string borders, wide sleeves pushed up to the elbow, a sash of pale silk tied in a loose knot with a long bamboo flute thrust through it, a plain tube with a tassel of green thread, its length drawn in the lower frame. Hands and objects: the right arm hugs a pile of paper sheets with little drawings of dots and lines tight against the chest; the left hand makes a blessing gesture. Background: the rim path along the edge of a deep ravine of pines in mist, a wooden rail, a pilgrim's broad straw hat and grey cloak in blur, a distant waterfall, a brightening sky of pale blue. Power: a few green motes of wood qi drift out of the flute's mouth like tiny leaves. Light: bright cool light from the upper left with a soft rim on her hair. Expression: a brazen, persuasive grin, the gap showing and the bright eyes holding the pilgrim's, a girl already counting the offering.

people.imagined: On the lower terrace, sitting still but his right hand taps the quarry-hammer beat on his thigh, over and over, while he looks calmly at the marching drill beyond.
people.subject: The moment: sitting still on a terrace with his right hand tapping a steady beat on his thigh, looking calmly forward. Face: a calm square young face; skin tanned grey with stone dust; steady dark eyes; level brows; a broad nose; a quiet closed mouth. Hair: short black, a fine grey stone dust powdered through it, tied in a small knot with a plain pin. Body: broad-shouldered, solid and strong for his age, the back straight, the shoulders relaxed. Clothing: the plain, graceful grey silk of an outer disciple, clean, two crossed collars with a thin silver pine border, the wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, a plain silk cord sash. Hands and objects: the right hand, lifted slightly above the thigh, is blurred at the top of its tap; the left, square and stone-dusted, holds a small drum stick and rests still on the left knee. Background: a flat stone shelf above a pine ravine, a row of students seated in grey at the next level with their zithers, a drill of marchers in the distance in a blur, a quarry hammer propped by his foot, a soft pearl-grey sky. Power: a faint brown-gold earth-qi shimmer rises like heat from the stone under him, pulsing with each tap. Light: soft pearl moonlight from the upper left, a gentle rim along the jaw. Expression: a steady, level, untroubled gaze, the quiet mouth closed and the dark eyes fixed ahead, as dependable as the beat.

people.imagined: Remembered: the abbot of the withered tree playing his zither under the pines, his own tree-bark robe grey like the trunk behind him, a faint ghost of leaf-drop starting in the branches.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of an abbot of fifty-five seated cross-legged under a great pine, playing a pine zither with a calm face, the bark behind him already pale and dry. Face: a lean, serene monk's face; shaved head; skin pale brown; closed or half-closed eyes; calm straight brows; a long nose; a gentle faint smile; a deep line on each side of the mouth. Hair: none; a shaved scalp marked with nine small round scars. Body: tall, thin and still, upright in a lotus pose, the spine straight as the pine behind him. Clothing: the robes of a founding abbot in pale grey-brown silk the colour of dry bark, layered with two crossed collars and wide sleeves that stir in the wind, carefully hemmed, with a faint ravine-blue gauze scarf over the shoulders; a monk's deliberately simple garment with only a thin line of silver pine embroidery at the border. Hands and objects: both hands on the strings of a dark long pine zither across his knees; a string of twelve pine-seed beads hangs from his wrist. Background: a great pine whose lower branches are brown and bare, the grey ravine wall, mist drifting among the lower trunks, a few fallen needles on the stone. Power: a few faint green-brown motes of wood qi rise from the strings and fade. Light: dim moonlit grey from the upper left, faint on the shaved scalp. Expression: a calm, absorbed, faintly smiling look, the eyes half closed and the face turned a little toward the strings. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: Remembered: the master maker on the last evening, holding up an unstrung zither to the light of the window, running a thumb along the board, content.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the old master zither-maker at sixty, holding up an unstrung zither body to a window and looking along it. Face: a warm, broad, wrinkled face; skin brown and leathery; thick silver-white eyebrows; kind small dark eyes narrowed in craft; a wide nose; a content, broad mouth; a white beard trimmed square. Hair: thick white hair tied back under a pale grey silk cap with a small jade clasp. Body: heavy, broad and upright, half turned to the window with his weight forward, his beard stirring slightly with his breath. Clothing: a guest craftsman's fine grey silk robe with two crossed collars bordered in silver zither strings and pines, the wide sleeves tied back with silk cords, a cord sash, pale shavings dusting the shoulders. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long pale zither body, unstrung and without pegs, at eye level, the right thumb running along its edge; on the bench beside him a coil of silk strings tied with a red thread. Background: an old workshop, racks of seasoned boards in the shadows, a long row of hanging tools, curls of shaving on the floor, a half-carved zither on a stand, a low brazier, and through the window the last light over a ravine and the pines. Power: a gentle gold-green shimmer of wood qi lingers in the grain of the board. Light: warm low spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a content, expert, narrowed look along the wood, the broad mouth relaxed. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: In the drying yard among stacked pine boards, hefting one in both hands and counting aloud in sixes, the whole yard counting after him, while one board is set quietly apart under a cloth.
people.subject: The moment: in a timber yard, hefting a long pale pine board in both hands and counting aloud, mouth open on a number. Face: a square, stolid, brown face; thick dark brows; small shrewd eyes; a flat nose; a heavy jaw with a rough short beard; the mouth open mid-count. Hair: black, tied back with a silk cord and a plain pine-wood pin. Body: thick, strong and square, legs planted wide, the thick arms taking the weight of the board across his chest, the head tipped slightly back as he counts. Clothing: a grey silk robe of an inner disciple, clean and graceful, two crossed collars edged with a silver pine border, wide sleeves rolled to the elbow with silk ties, a wide silk sash with a small jade measuring rod tucked in, a few flecks of pale resin on the cuff. Hands and objects: both hands hold the long pale board across his chest. Background: a drying yard ranked with stacks of pale boards separated by sticks, each stack with a small painted dot, a tall dark pine at the edge, thin mist in the lower ground, and under a cloth in the corner a single board kept apart. Power: a thin pine-green shimmer of wood qi hangs along the length of the board like a held breath. Light: clear silvery light from the upper left with a soft rim along the board. Expression: a stolid, meticulous look, the small shrewd eyes fixed on the grain and the mouth open mid-count, nothing in the face but the number.

people.imagined: On the rim before the echo walls, a pine cone on a cord swung high, a big laugh, while the walls rattle back at her; pilgrims beside her stop and listen.
people.subject: The moment: laughing out loud on a high rim, swinging a pine cone on a cord above her head. Face: a round, rosy, laughing face; crinkled bright eyes; full cheeks; a wide mouth open in a big laugh; a short nose; strong dark brows. Hair: black in a thick coil, a pine needle tucked in beside a jade zither pin. Body: plump, strong and cheerful, the broad body thrown back in the laugh with the right arm high. Clothing: an inner disciple's soft grey silk with two crossed collars embroidered with zither strings in silver, wide sleeves that fall back to the elbow in long folds, a pale silk sash tied in a bow with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand whirls a large brown pine cone on a cord overhead, a blur at the top of its circle, the long pale nails showing on the cord; the left holds her plectrum. Background: a grey rock wall streaked with moss and rust-coloured bands, a few small ferns in the cracks, pilgrims in straw hats standing in a loose line below with their heads tilted, a wide pale sky with a high thin cloud and a hawk. Power: bright green motes of wood qi spin off the pine cone as it circles, and a few blue-white droplets of water qi sparkle in its wake. Light: bright silvery morning light from the upper left with a soft glow on her cheeks. Expression: a loud, merry, open-mouthed laugh with the eyes crinkled bright, a woman delighted by her own noise.

people.imagined: She sits quietly in the string room winding silk, her braid with a grey streak, singing the pines' phrase under her breath, while her cousin hovers by the door.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a winding frame, softly singing, a grey streak in her braid. Face: a thin, quiet, pale brown face; gentle dark eyes lowered; neat brows; a small nose; a closed mouth singing softly; flecks of green dust on the cheeks. Hair: a long black braid over her shoulder with a distinct streak of grey-white as wide as two fingers that shines silver, tied with a pale ribbon. Body: slight and quiet, sitting straight with her elbows in. Clothing: the simple graceful grey silk of an outer student, neat and clean, a crossed collar with a thin silver border of zither strings, wide sleeves tied back with silk cords, a small pouch of green wire at her belt. Hands and objects: both slender hands wind green-tinged silk on a wooden spool, the spool turning in her fingers. Background: a room full of hanging silk skeins and winding frames, a small window of white light with a pine branch in it, a miner's pick hung on a nail as a keepsake, a cup of tea going cold, and a young man's shape at the doorway, her cousin, waiting. Power: a faint pale-gold shimmer of metal qi follows the thread as it winds, and the green dust on her cheeks glints like tiny motes. Light: soft misty window light from the upper left, a silver rim on the grey streak. Expression: a humble, quiet, singing look, the gentle eyes lowered and the closed mouth soft on the note.

people.imagined: In the middle of a movement he cannot stay in, shifting in his seat, his belt notched with tally marks, plucking louder than the walls answer.
people.subject: The moment: playing loudly on a zither while twisting restlessly in his seat, eyes on the door. Face: a broad, tanned, impatient face; bright restless dark eyes cast sideways; heavy brows; a snub nose; a mouth set in a pout. Hair: black hair roughly tied with a cord and a plain wooden pin. Body: wiry and big-handed, perched on the very edge of the seat with one knee up and the heel jittering, the shoulders twisted toward the door and the neck craned; his hands are rough with a woodcutter's calluses. Clothing: the simple graceful grey silk of an outer student, clean but rumpled, two crossed collars with a thin silver pine border, wide sleeves pushed up, a silk sash notched with a long row of small cuts and tied with a small jade hatchet charm. Hands and objects: both hands hard on the strings. Background: a dim pine hall, a row of other students at their zithers in blur, a bright rectangle of open doorway with the green of the ravine beyond, a few motes in the beam, a bamboo screen half drawn. Power: a few green motes of wood qi jump from the strings with every hard note. Light: bright silvery light from the doorway at the right, a rim along the cheek and shoulder. Expression: a restless, eager, sulky look, the bright dark eyes pulled sideways to the open door and the mouth set in a pout, wanting to be gone.

people.imagined: At a recital, biting the inside of her cheek at someone else's wrong note, her face smooth and sweet above it, her own hands ready on the strings.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a zither, biting the inside of her cheek, hands poised for a shrill note. Face: a pretty, sharp face; the left cheek visibly pulled in at the corner where she bites it; cold bright eyes; thin arched brows; a narrow nose; a thin smile. Hair: black, in an immaculate high knot with a slender silver pin. Body: slim, poised and arrogant, sitting with a perfectly straight back and the chin lifted. Clothing: an inner student's spotless fine grey silk, a high crossed inner collar and two outer collars embroidered in silver zither strings, wide sleeves in precise folds, the sash tied in a flat exact bow with a small white jade pendant; the silver pin in her hair catches the light. Hands and objects: both hands hover over the strings like blades, the nails of the right long, pale and sharp. Background: a pale, spare hall with a row of seated students in blurred grey and a few faces turned toward her, one boy covering his ears; lamps hang from the beams, the floor is polished to a shine, a paper screen shows the dark shapes of pines. Power: a few sharp green motes of wood qi quiver in the air above the strings, and cool blue droplets of water qi fall away from her fingertips. Light: bright cold moonlight from the upper left, a hard rim along the nails. Expression: a cold, contemptuous, thin smile, the bright eyes fixed on someone out of frame with the cheek drawn in, a girl waiting for a mistake.

people.imagined: Before dawn, tuning the heir's zither by lamp, turning his head just a beat late as someone speaks to him, as if the words must be tuned first.
people.subject: The moment: tuning a zither before dawn by lamp, head tilting a beat late toward a speaker. Face: a plain, gentle, earnest face; mild brown eyes, a beat late; level brows; a straight nose; a mouth about to answer. Hair: short brown, neatly combed, a small wooden pin in a tiny knot. Body: lean, careful and still, sitting cross-legged before the zither with his back straight, the head tilting a fraction late toward a voice from the left. Clothing: a clean, neat inner student's grey silk robe with two crossed collars edged in silver zither strings, wide sleeves tied back with silk cords, a plain silk sash; a small tuning fork of pale metal lies on the floor beside his knee. Hands and objects: the right hand on a tuning peg; the left plucking a string, the hands at work without a pause. Background: a cold hall before dawn, a single lamp on a low stand throwing a yellow pool, bare boards, a paper window showing a grey sliver of coming dawn, and beyond the lamp's reach a small figure sitting in the shadows, perfectly still, with her hands on a zither. Power: a thin gold shimmer of metal qi hums along the string he plucks. Light: warm lamp light from the lower left with a soft glow on the silk. Expression: a sincere, slow, earnest look, the mild brown eyes arriving a beat late at the speaker and the mouth just parting to answer.

people.imagined: Drumming on a rail with both hands, a green cord knotted at his wrist, his gaze on a column of marchers.
people.subject: The moment: drumming on a wooden rail with both hands, eyes on a distant marching column. Face: a lean, hard-set young face, flushed with effort; fierce dark eyes fixed on the road; strong straight brows; a firm mouth; a muscle in the jaw. Hair: black, in a long plait tied with a plain cord, swinging with the beat. Body: lean, wiry and restless, standing at the rail with the shoulders squared, elbows loose, head up, the body swaying with the rhythm. Clothing: the simple graceful grey silk of an outer student, clean, two crossed collars with a thin silver border, wide sleeves pushed up; a faded green soldier's cord knotted tight round the left wrist, plainly visible; a pair of drumsticks tucked into his silk sash. Hands and objects: both hands raised and mid-beat on the wooden rail, the knuckles pale. Background: a terrace edge looking across a misty ravine to a distant road where a column of soldiers marches in a thin dark line under an unmarked green banner, pines in mist below, a hawk gliding, and a second boy, stocky and calm, drumming softly on his knee beside him in blur. Power: pale green motes of wood qi jump from the rail with every beat and drift toward the road. Light: bright silvery afternoon light from the upper left, hard on the rail and the drumming hands. Expression: an eager, burning, hungry stare at the distant column, the fierce eyes unblinking and the mouth firm, a boy wanting to march.
